displayName: NoETL EHDB: event-log tier DEMOTED — it is no longer serving

conditions.displayName: NoETL EHDB: event-log tier DEMOTED — it is no longer serving

documentation.content: The EHDB event-log tier is configured `primary` but a serve decision returned ServedByIncumbent. Callers still get correct answers from the incumbent store, which is why nothing else fails and no dashboard turns red — the demotion is SILENT. Check the writer's tier-service listener (:9110), the writer PVC, and `noetl_ehdb_dataplane_ops_total{operation=~"tier_service.*"}`. Instant mitigation is to set the tier back to shadow: `kubectl -n noetl set env deploy/noetl-worker-rust deploy/noetl-worker-system-pool deploy/noetl-worker-system-pool-shard1 NOETL_EHDB_EVENTLOG=shadow` — no image change. NOTE: served_primary is per-pod; this query sums across replicas deliberately. Ref noetl/ai-meta#257.
